popupInfo.title: Near-term, Stormwater Flooding
popupInfo.description: Approximate stormwater flooding extents from a 10-year, 24-hour rainfall event, with 9-inch sea level rise (5.6-inch rainfall, expected around 2030s-2050s). Source: Boston Water Sewer Commission. Note: This data should not be used for detailed analysis as it does not necessarily identify all areas subject to flooding particularly from local drainage sources of small size. Users should be aware that inundation areas are calculated by mathematical models with precision that is limited to historical calibrations.
